forum.title: STEF033AJR usage
forum.best_answer_content:
Welcome @hk1, to the community!

If you actually need Ilimit at 1A, the STEF033 is unfortunately not suitable. Please also read sections 5.2 and 5.1.4 of the [data sheet](https://www.st.com/resource/en/datasheet/stef033.pdf) so that you understand the difference between Ilimit and Ishort.

Increasing the Rlimit beyond 120 ohms serves no purpose, as the curve begins to approach an asymptote at that point, meaning the current limit becomes increasingly unpredictable.

Hope that answers your questions?

Regards

/Peter
